text: Then glycoproteins: proteins with carbohydrate chains attached. Some of the proteins you've already placed are glycoproteins. This receptor carries a short chain beside its binding site, and this protein at the end carries a longer one. Their protein parts sit in the bilayer like the other membrane proteins, but their carbohydrate chains project from the outer surface into the watery surroundings, just like the glycolipid's. Not every membrane protein carries a chain: in our membrane, the channel and the carrier don't.
